svg.title: brutex
svg.desc:
The brand mark, taken from web/design/ingest.html, where .brand .mark is a 22px rounded square filled with a 140deg gradient from the accent hue to the info hue, carrying the glyph in the on-accent ink. Those three theme tokens are spelled here as the literals the DARK ramp resolves them to, because an icon cannot read a custom property, and the dark pair is the saturated one so it stays legible against a light browser tab as well as a dark one.
The X is a stroked path and not a text glyph: text would resolve against whatever font the viewer happens to have, and a mark that changes shape per machine is not a mark.
NOTE FOR ANY LATER EDITOR: this is a desc element and not a comment, and that is deliberate. The token names in this file's own design system begin with a double hyphen, and a double hyphen is illegal inside an XML comment. Written as a comment, this file parsed as an error document, served 200, and every browser fell back to asking for /favicon.ico.
